verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot is a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate coding tasks to via Agent mode, which analyzes codebases and autonomously generates multi-file edits (github-docs-2, github-docs-13), assign PR reviews to (github-docs-9), and even assign project tasks to from mobile (github-docs-4). This shows genuine task delegation beyond simple autocomplete, with first-party documentation and some independent community corroboration of Copilot quality (github-comm-12). Missing for 10: deeper independent hands-on validation specifically of autonomous agent-mode task completion (most community evidence concerns unrelated outages/pricing) and more detail on limits/reliability of delegated agent tasks.
